description: The UCS-4 / UTF-8 / UTF-16 coded-character-set phrases of the ALPHABET ... FOR NATIONAL clause, ISO 12.3.7.2 - introduced 2002 with the national class (UCS-4 names both a coded set and the ISO 10646-order collating sequence; UTF-8/UTF-16 name coded sets only, Table 6). Context-sensitive words (8.9, ALPHABET-clause scope) recognized BY TEXT in the parse arm (VisitAlphabetClause) - no lexer keywords.
citation: ISO §2023:12.3.7.2 alphabet-name-clause (the FOR NATIONAL branch); §2023:8.9 context-sensitive words UCS-4/UTF-8/UTF-16; §2023:12.3.7.4 GR7
vcr: 2002 introduction (the national class; the ALPHABET national branch arrived with it)
